contract: Drive the Matroska, ISO BMFF, TS188 and M2TS192 AnyReader source lifecycle under the ContainerReader and InputRequest API contracts. Test known and unknown source length with both random-access and sequential capabilities.

Compare the exposed capabilities before and after restart. Require every reset to issue an offset-zero request with the source and token used by the next step. The parser may ask for a shorter first window. Reject a failure from the wrong source or old generation and check persistent Transport and Cancelled outcomes before resetting.
Fold the Transport and Cancelled cycles as kinds 1 and 2. Every row records the source length (zero when unknown) and the random-access flag.
